meta.title: Vietnam’s Most Beautiful Railway: The Heritage Train & Hai Van Pass | Da Nang to Hue
meta.description:
Experience the most scenic train journey in Vietnam! Crossing the legendary Hai Van Pass on the Heritage Train (Hành trình kết nối di sản miền Trung) from Da Nang to Hue.

In this video, there’s no talking — just the authentic sounds of the railway, the breathtaking views of Lang Co Bay, and the unique atmosphere inside the carriages. From a spontaneous Bollywood-style party with fellow travelers to beautiful live Vietnamese music in the buffet car, this is more than just a commute — it's a 3-hour cultural experience.

What’s inside:

00:00 Departure from Da Nang Station

15:45 Climbing the Hai Van Pass

20:20 Incredible views of the East Sea

32:15 Live traditional music in the Cafe Car

45:30 Arriving at Hue Station

Details:

Train: Heritage Train (HD1/HD2)

Route: Da Nang (Đà Nẵng) — Hue (Huế)

Duration: ~3,5 hours

Price: ~240,000 VND
